neighbours.label: a body-part or mind noun used figuratively in an idiom (in the minds of, caught the eye of, at the hands of, from his hand)
fire: Safety was uppermost in the minds of the engineers who designed the tunnel.
A small painting in the corner caught the eye of the visiting collector.
The rebels suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of the royal army.
Years of propaganda had planted the idea firmly in the minds of the villagers.
That trip to the refugee camp really opened her eyes to the scale of the crisis.
The new mayor quickly won the hearts of the fishermen in the harbor town.
Every dress in the collection came from the hand of a single designer.
The striking red logo is meant to catch the eye of shoppers walking past.
